quarterly_data.quarter: Fuso Chemical annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management states it expects AI demand, the continued increase in CMP processes and miniaturisation to drive further demand growth for its ultra-high-purity colloidal silica, and that its customers' own demand forecasts project average annual growth of 8-10% through the company's fiscal year 2030 (April 2030 - March 2031). Capacity status: Kashima phase I has run at full operation since the end of the fiscal year to March 2025 after customer certification; the Kyoto new line was certified earlier than expected and moved to a set-up able to run at full operation from the end of the fiscal year to March 2026; certification activity has started for Kashima phase II. Planned-facilities table: Kyoto site ultra-high-purity colloidal silica plant and ancillary facilities, total planned investment JPY 40,000 million, JPY 403 million already paid, construction started March 2026, completion February 2029 (management: capacity up 20% versus the fiscal year to March 2026 once running). High-concentration, high-productivity grades increased their share of total production.
quarterly_data.figure: customers' demand forecasts 8-10% average annual growth through fiscal year 2030 (April 2030 - March 2031); Kyoto plant JPY 40,000 million (JPY 403 million paid)

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuso Chemical annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditure in the fiscal year to March 2026 by segment: Electronic Materials JPY 7,926,324 thousand (mainly construction of the ultra-high-purity colloidal silica plant and ancillary facilities at the Kashima site), Life Science JPY 2,734,438 thousand (mainly seismic reinforcement at the Osaka plant), corporate JPY 126,890 thousand (design costs for a new research centre), total JPY 10,787,652 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: Electronic Materials capex JPY 7,926,324 thousand; total JPY 10,787,652 thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuso Chemical annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual securities report): R&D expenses JPY 1,091 million in the fiscal year to March 2026 (Electronic Materials JPY 718 million, Life Science JPY 365 million). For its Quartron ultra-high-purity colloidal silica for semiconductor polishing slurries, the company is developing products that meet customer performance requirements for the 1.8nm technology node and beyond, and several new products with improved productivity, with good results in customer evaluations; it continues development, certification and sample work for A16 / A14-generation requirements, and its new materials / new-application products have drawn inquiries from multiple companies. The company plans a new combined R&D centre for both businesses, targeting start of operation in its fiscal year April 2028 - March 2029.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 1,091 million (Electronic Materials JPY 718 million)

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuso Chemical annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management on the external environment: US-China trade friction had no direct impact - no direct effect from reciprocal tariffs and none from semiconductor export / import controls; to secure metallic silicon, the main raw material of ultra-high-purity colloidal silica, the company ran test purchases from several countries and now has multiple suppliers; selling prices were broadly maintained in the fiscal year to March 2026 while yen-weakness and inflation cost increases were passed on to customers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuso Chemical annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Life Science segment (fruit and organic acids, food-additive formulations), fiscal year to March 2026: sales JPY 35,411 million (-2.4%), operating profit JPY 5,308 million (+0.4%); company plan for fiscal 2026 (year to March 2027): sales JPY 36,400 million, operating profit JPY 5,500 million. Malic acid volumes rose 20% YoY on new customers and share gains; US subsidiary PMP Fermentation Products' gluconate volumes rose 10%, and it is investing in added crystallizers and other equipment with operation planned from July 2027; FFA formulation capacity at the Qingdao (China) subsidiary was expanded about 1.5 times.
quarterly_data.figure: Life Science sales JPY 35,411 million (-2.4%); plan JPY 36,400 million
